ARC-05.text: Chosen option: Frame and notice only. RichView goes all in on WebGL for very high performance with many points. All major browsers must work, Safari, Firefox and Chrome in reasonably recent versions; where JavaScript or WebGL is unavailable, the chart's frame shows a notice that the chart cannot be displayed. No static snapshot, image or table fallback is built.
ARC-05.note: Dictated by Daniel in the review chat on 2026-10-26: "We should strive for all major browsers to work, Safari, Mozilla and Chrome, with some reasonable build, but we should show a notice that stuff doesn't work if not. We should always strive for WebGL; let's go for WebGL. I want it super high performant with a lot of points." Recorded by the lockdown agent at his request.
